title: Recover a split and recombine private forces
description: Four independent commanders enter through actual authenticated controls. Formation supplies real forces; a withheld split survives reload with one command identity, then leased settlement splits and recombines the complement once. Owner and other-player views show private orders and outcomes. Fixed catalogue/domain clocks are explicit harness controls. Development transport capacity and tick rules remain under review; this does not certify travel, managed encryption or hosted scheduling.
